units.source_text: 北面的纸隔扇都已除去，挂着帘子。

en.t: The paper sliding screens on the north side had all been removed, and curtains were hanging there.

units.source_text: 众侍女都退往那边，周围清静了，

en.t: The ladies in waiting had all withdrawn that way, and the surroundings had grown quiet,

units.source_text: 源氏便把参与法会时须知之事预先教导三公主，

en.t: Genji then instructed the Third Princess in advance about what she needed to know when taking part in the Buddhist service,
and his thoughtfulness was deeply moving.

units.source_text: 他看见公主让出自己的起居室来供奉佛像，心中不胜感慨，

en.t: Seeing that the princess had given up her own living room to enshrine the Buddhist image, he was overcome with emotion,

units.source_text: 对她说道：“我和你两人共同经营佛堂，真乃意想不到之事！

en.t: and said to her, "That you and I should prepare a Buddhist hall together is truly something I never expected!

units.source_text: 但愿后世同生极乐净土，在同一莲花中亲睦共处。”

en.t: May we be born together in the Pure Land in the life to come, and live affectionately in the same lotus blossom."
Having said this, he shed tears and composed a poem:
